items.description: The flat arch of the Santo Domingo church, an architectural wonder that stood for centuries without support. It proves the ingenuity of colonial builders.
A well-preserved historical residence reflecting the colonial style of Panama City. It offers a glimpse into early residential life.
A plaza in Casco Viejo dedicated to the French effort in building the Panama Canal. It honors the historical ties between France and Panama.
A prominent neo-Gothic church in Panama City. Its striking architecture makes it one of the most recognizable landmarks in the capital.
A historic church in Casco Viejo with a facade moved from the original Panama City. It is highly valued for its colonial preservation.
A modern venue designed for large international events. It enhances Panama's status as a hub for global conferences.
Renowned for its Baroque golden altar, this church is a key cultural landmark. It attracts visitors interested in colonial art.
A modern high-rise that defines the skyline of Panama City. It is a symbol of the country's economic development and modernity.
